name: Research Topic Recommendation & Feasibility Analysis
description: A multi-agent research discovery system that recommends evidence-backed, novel, feasible topics from a researcher’s interests, skills, available resources and timeline.

name: MemoryLens
description: Offline, privacy-preserving file assistant for searching and chatting with local PDFs, codebases and text using semantic retrieval and summarization.

name: CycleCura
description: Personalized menstrual cycle prediction and PCOS/PCOD risk awareness using machine learning, feature engineering and historical cycle data; designed for awareness, not diagnosis.

name: Agriculture Price Prediction
description: Stacking ensemble learning to forecast agricultural commodity prices using historical market data, engineered features and model evaluation.

name: TrendPlus
description: Trend analysis platform for discovering emerging patterns and transforming complex data into organized, actionable research insights.

name: LungTwin
description: AI-assisted lung digital twin concept for visualizing anatomical structures and exploring disease-related changes for medical education and research.

name: SIT Chatbot
description: Conversational college information assistant for questions about academics, admissions, facilities, departments and institutional services.

name: Personalized Learning Path Recommender
description: Semantic retrieval system ranking Top-10 relevant learning paths from learner reviews using embedding-based matching and multi-stage candidate ranking.

name: EkLink — Unified Smart Campus Ecosystem
description: One identity, five connected campus applications: TemplateOS, Infivoice, ApproveIt, Attendie and SlotIt, linked by SSO and role-based access.
